conclusion: No false same-execution claim or file-SHA compatibility regression found. Legacy R3 v4 provenance remains accepted structurally as an explicitly different execution path with sequence TIS; actual pending data remains nontrainable because the real reference is absent. Frozen numerics r4 and current v5/history sources are separate. New main100 child/parent frozen-copy references match.
scope: Read-only source/artifact audit plus actual binding/prepare functions on unchanged real pending rows and a clearly metadata-only learner identity counterpart. No model load, reference completion, behavior rescore, CT/oracle rerun, optimizer, GPU, heldout or source changes.

binding_current.identity_difference: Probability execution profile/runtime only; all other fields match exactly

pending.learner_counterpart_boundary: Actual sampled weight/protocol fields copied; execution-only hashes deliberately differ to exercise API compatibility. Not an actually loaded/scored learner or proof of numeric equality.

negative_cases.message: Unsloth actor binding requires explicit sequence_tis correction
Unsloth actor and learner have different weights, adapter or protocol
Unsloth actor runtime provenance differs from its policy identity

pending.runtime_validation_meaning: Binding verifies known profile equality, policy/runtime payload hashes, unchanged weight/protocol core and effective scaling. It intentionally does not require old runtime source SHA equal the current local file; provenance is a recorded-source identity, not an allowlist of every implementation hash. No runtime hash was rewritten in the real input.

configuration_mapping: cache_tokens>0, rewind=True -> v5; zero-cache rewind rejected

raw-preserved/canonical-ct-v1 are collector conditioning contracts, independently source-pinned in bootstrap/queue/ledger; given exact prompt IDs they do not alone rename the numerical probability profile. Canonical without rewind can miss strict-prefix cache and recompute safely.
profiles.default_false_runtime: No session_prefix_rewind key when false; current source SHA still changes the runtime identity. History default raw is omitted as before; opt-in canonical includes history_format and history_source_sha256.

frozen_numerics_r4.loader: Carrier decodes its SOURCE_BUNDLE and overwrites packaged source paths before child processes; no substitution from the current workspace. Frozen binding CPU function used frozen AST and verified-identical v3/v4 profile values only.

main100_trainer_r3.cycle_boundary: Child pins the pre-recommendation parent frozen copy. Current parent may point to child; current parent is not substituted for that frozen copy. No file includes its own digest.
